ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 45% high-intensity (off-white/cream) pixels and 55% low-intensity (dark charcoal/black) pixels across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe (viewer's left) features a large contiguous white field containing three distinct vertical dark bands. Right lobe (viewer's right) is primarily dark with a thin, high-intensity band along the anterior edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge topography with localized high-frequency, high-amplitude pixel variations (protrusions) at the far left distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a broad convex curve transitioning to a rounded tip; right lobe displays a significantly more elongated and slender sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-contrast circular pixel formations (barnacle colony) on the distal edge of the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel, dark vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) situated within the white pigmentation zone of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on the left lobe and significant barnacle encrustations on the left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'claw-shaped' pigmentation pattern consisting of three dark vertical strokes against the white background of the left lobe.
